review_scope: Read-only independent product review of the exact production sources in the redaction-aware r4 target manifest.
verified: complete/handoff_accepted output requires exact identity and expected-SHA readback before completed_attempt_output is emitted.
Missing/unreadable successful output records a cause-bearing gap and cannot fall through to failure_handoff.
Non-success handoffs retain strict invocation, identity, stage, content, and allowed outcome checks.
The normal author and reviewer-driven revision share the single exact raw allowed path prompt.
scope_limitations: reporting.py renderer and evidence allowlist internals were outside scope and were not reviewed.
